title: Market Research card catalog (mr.catalog/1)
description: Every card legal in Standard in at least one ban list of the window. Titles come from the NetrunnerDB catalog only.

schema.description: Schema ID and major version of this file.

version.description: Snapshot version this file belongs to: the UTC start time of the pipeline run that published it, as YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Same as the v=<version>/ folder the file is in and the manifest's version.

restrictions.description: Ban lists the snapshot has data for, oldest first (the same IDs as the manifest, without all).

cards.description: Every card legal in Standard under at least one of those ban lists, sorted by id.

id.description: Card ID from the catalog (the NetrunnerDB card ID, the same across printings).

title.description: Card title from the NetrunnerDB catalog.

side.description: Side the card belongs to: corp or runner.

type.description: Card type ID from NetrunnerDB, e.g. ice, agenda, program, corp_identity.

faction.description: Faction ID from NetrunnerDB, e.g. jinteki, anarch, neutral_corp.

printings.description: NetrunnerDB printing IDs of the card, sorted.

legal_in.description: Ban lists (from restrictions) under which the card is legal in Standard.

banned_in.description: Ban lists (from restrictions) that ban the card. A ban list missing from both this and legal_in left the card out of its card pool (not yet released, or rotated).
